statement: The captured retail HID descriptor matches the published 217-byte rnconrad candidate digest exactly. It and the current 217-byte virtualgamepad synthetic descriptor declare one Generic Desktop Game Pad Application collection and the same vendor-page 0xFF00 report IDs and payload lengths. Retail main items are Data/Array/Absolute (0x00) and the interim main items are Data/Variable/Absolute (0x02). Both declare speaker output IDs 0x14, 0x18 and 0x19 with 1, 21 and 1 payload bytes respectively, excluding the report ID, and no Feature reports. The older C5 synthetic descriptor has a vendor top-level collection and lacks those three speaker outputs.

applicability.revision: Owner-reported case model RVL-036 (Wii Remote Plus), Bluetooth name Nintendo RVL-CNT-01
applicability.scope: One retail RVL-036 with the RVL-CNT-01 Bluetooth identity. Other controller specimens and revisions, including RVL-CNT-01-TR, were not measured. The comparison concerns descriptor declarations. Live report behavior and speaker audio were outside the run.
